title: OFSCP Follow (v0.1)
description: A channel the authenticated user follows (§7.6). A follow is a pointer only — the channel's home provider remains the single source of truth; the client composes its home feed by reading each followed channel live.

channel.description: Reference to the followed channel — a URI for remote channels (§2.4); MAY be a local id for same-provider channels.

groupId.description: Optional reference to the channel's group, for client convenience.
